text:
```yaml
name: Deploy Website

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up .NET Core
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
      with:
        dotnet-version: '6.0'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: dotnet restore

    - name: Build and publish website
      run: ./Website/build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI -PSWriteOfficeRoot /Support/GitHub/PSWriteOffice

    - name: Validate website locally
      run: |
        cd Website
        dotnet run --project Website.csproj -- --validate

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./Website/dist
        cname: officeimo.com
        force_orphan: true
        keep_files: false

    - name: Ingest PSWriteOffice API
      run: |
        cd Website
        dotnet run --project Website.csproj -- --ingest-api /Support/GitHub/PSWriteOffice

    - name: Generate OfficeIMO API
      run: |
        cd Website
        dotnet run --project Website.csproj -- --generate-api

    - name: Polish landing pages
      run: |
        cd Website
        dotnet run --project Website.csproj -- --polish-landing-pages

    - name: Fix PR workflows and parser issues
      run: |
        cd Website
        dotnet run --project Website.csproj -- --fix-pr-workflows
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a pipeline for building, deploying, and maintaining the OfficeIMO website on GitHub Pages. It includes steps for validating the website locally, ingesting the PSWriteOffice API, generating the OfficeIMO API, and polishing the landing pages. The workflow triggers on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch.

    - name: Install dependencies

    - name: Build and publish website

    - name: Validate website locally

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
